queries: WITH type_avgs AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS type_avg FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS baseline_price FROM Products), kept AS (SELECT t.production_type_code, t.type_avg FROM type_avgs t CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE t.type_avg > b.baseline_price), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(type_avg) AS mean_price FROM kept), remaining AS (SELECT k.type_avg FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_mean m WHERE k.type_avg > m.mean_price) SELECT AVG(r.type_avg) AS average_type_price, AVG(r.type_avg - b.baseline_price) AS average_above_baseline, AVG(r.type_avg - m.mean_price) AS average_above_kept_mean FROM baseline b CROSS JOIN kept_mean m LEFT JOIN remaining r ON 1 = 1 WHERE b.baseline_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.baseline_price, m.mean_price

WITH type_averages AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS type_avg FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS overall_avg FROM Products HAVING COUNT(unit_price) > 0), kept AS (SELECT t.production_type_code, t.type_avg FROM type_averages t CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE t.type_avg > b.overall_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(type_avg) AS mean_avg FROM kept), remaining AS (SELECT k.type_avg, k.type_avg - b.overall_avg AS above_baseline, k.type_avg - m.mean_avg AS above_kept_mean FROM kept k CROSS JOIN baseline b CROSS JOIN kept_mean m WHERE k.type_avg > m.mean_avg) SELECT AVG(r.type_avg) AS avg_type_price, AVG(r.above_baseline) AS avg_above_baseline, AVG(r.above_kept_mean) AS avg_above_kept_mean FROM baseline b LEFT JOIN remaining r ON 1 = 1 GROUP BY b.overall_avg

WITH type_averages AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS type_average FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS overall_average FROM Products), kept_types AS (SELECT t.production_type_code, t.type_average FROM type_averages t CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE t.type_average > b.overall_average), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(type_average) AS average_of_kept_types FROM kept_types), remaining_types AS (SELECT k.type_average FROM kept_types k CROSS JOIN kept_mean m WHERE k.type_average > m.average_of_kept_types) SELECT AVG(r.type_average) AS average_type_price, AVG(r.type_average - b.overall_average) AS average_above_baseline, AVG(r.type_average - m.average_of_kept_types) AS average_above_kept_mean FROM baseline b CROSS JOIN kept_mean m LEFT JOIN remaining_types r ON 1 = 1 WHERE b.overall_average IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.overall_average, m.average_of_kept_types;
